description: Corrected lightmap / night-lighting batch derived from the same base composition. Each image is a labeled lighting pass or mood variant intended to keep the parked car and scene composition consistent.

images.description: Base corrected night scene with stable geometry and stable parked car; no dominant active emissive source, only dark night ambience and wet street readability.
Pharmacy cross as the primary active light source. Green spill on facade, sidewalk, wet ground, and subtle tint on the parked car.
Sparse warm miscellaneous city windows and distant pinlights. Very subtle urban occupancy lights with limited spill.
Warm bar light: sign plus interior bottle shelves and warm spill on the right storefront and wet pavement.
Full composite mood variant with multiple sources active together, including reflections on wet street and light interaction across the scene.
Vertical KLUB sign as the primary source. Cold blue spill localized around the club facade and pavement.
Mostly localized BAR sign / storefront glow with restrained spill and low overall ambient contribution.
Cool apteka interior light as the primary source, emphasizing pharmacy windows, frames, and cool reflections.
CZARNY SEN main sign and entrance lighting as the primary source, with cold blue spill at the central building and street center.
